plurals.name: tool_warning_characters_replaced

plurals.item: %1$d 個欄位名稱在表格中不存在, 已忽略: %2$s.

plurals.name: tool_warning_remote_resources_blocked
plurals.item: %1$d 項外部網絡資源沒有載入.

plurals.name: tool_warning_signatures_invalidated
plurals.item: %1$d 個已簽署的簽名欄位因填寫而失效.
